records.source: This paints behind every module screen, on machines that are simultaneously running Cellpose on a GPU and a 40-plate pipeline, so cost is a correctness requirement rather than a nicety. Two things get it there:
records.translation: Esto se pinta detrás de cada pantalla de módulo, en máquinas que al mismo tiempo ejecutan Cellpose en una GPU y un pipeline de 40 placas, por lo que el coste es un requisito de corrección y no un detalle. Dos cosas lo consiguen:

records.context: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on application view* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These application views stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual application view-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own independent execution path* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the main GUI execution path's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a workflow is executing.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#16
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on screen* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These screens stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual screen-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own thread* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the GUI thread's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a pipeline is running.
records.translation: 1. *El temporizador se detiene siempre que el widget no está en pantalla* — oculto, en otra pestaña o en una ventana minimizada. Cero fotogramas, cero CPU. Estas pantallas permanecen abiertas durante horas, así que esto es lo decisivo. 2. *Los temas difusos se pintan en una QImage pequeña reutilizable y se escalan*. El lado largo del búfer es el que declara el tema (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) multiplicado por el ajuste de resolución del usuario, de modo que los campos difusos sombrean ~37 000 píxeles en lugar de ~2 000 000. Los materiales de aurora y de arte de datos conservan el detalle nativo de la pantalla dentro del presupuesto real de píxeles de pantalla. Aurora devuelve un fotograma propio, lo que evita una segunda copia a tamaño completo cuando un trabajador de sombreado lo publica. 3. *El sombreado se realiza en su propio hilo* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), de modo que toda la parte de un fotograma que corresponde al hilo de la GUI es un ``drawImage``. Esa es la sección siguiente, y es la que importa mientras se ejecuta un pipeline.

records.context: So **CPU saturation is not a cause**: numpy releases the interpreter lock and a core burning flat out costs this module nothing. **A signal flood is not a cause on its own**: 200 lines a second are free, and it only bites in the thousands, where the console's own per-line work saturates the main GUI execution path and nothing in *this* module can help. What is left is **the interpreter lock**: identical drawing work, eleven times slower, because the shading pass is Python and numpy and something else is holding the lock.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#33
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So **CPU saturation is not a cause**: numpy releases the interpreter lock and a core burning flat out costs this module nothing. **A signal flood is not a cause on its own**: 200 lines a second are free, and it only bites in the thousands, where the console's own per-line work saturates the GUI thread and nothing in *this* module can help. What is left is **the interpreter lock**: identical drawing work, eleven times slower, because the shading pass is Python and numpy and something else is holding the lock.
records.translation: Así que **la saturación de la CPU no es una causa**: numpy libera el bloqueo del intérprete y un núcleo trabajando a pleno rendimiento no le cuesta nada a este módulo. **Una avalancha de señales no es una causa por sí sola**: 200 líneas por segundo no cuestan nada, y solo afecta a partir de miles, cuando el propio trabajo por línea de la consola satura el hilo de la GUI y nada en *este* módulo puede ayudar. Lo que queda es **el bloqueo del intérprete**: el mismo trabajo de dibujo, once veces más lento, porque la pasada de sombreado es Python y numpy y otra cosa está reteniendo el bloqueo.

Two levers finish the job and neither is in this file — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` in the Qt bootstrap (measured independently: 32 % of the frame rate to 99 %, for about 6 % of the worker's throughput) and coalescing ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.

records.context: Three constraints shape the implementation. Animation periods are sampled from continuous ranges rather than replayed from a precomputed loop, avoiding visible jumps and large frame caches. Shading runs outside the main GUI execution path; if a frame is late, the previous frame is repeated and counted by :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. The animation clock remains on the main GUI execution path, and rendered frames remain deterministic functions of ``(seed, clock, size)``.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#56
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three constraints shape the implementation. Animation periods are sampled from continuous ranges rather than replayed from a precomputed loop, avoiding visible jumps and large frame caches. Shading runs outside the GUI thread; if a frame is late, the previous frame is repeated and counted by :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. The animation clock remains on the GUI thread, and rendered frames remain deterministic functions of ``(seed, clock, size)``.
records.translation: Tres restricciones determinan la implementación. Los periodos de animación se muestrean a partir de rangos continuos en lugar de reproducirse desde un bucle precalculado, lo que evita saltos visibles y grandes cachés de fotogramas. El sombreado se ejecuta fuera del hilo de la GUI; si un fotograma llega tarde, se repite el anterior y se cuenta en :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. El reloj de la animación permanece en el hilo de la GUI, y los fotogramas renderizados siguen siendo funciones deterministas de ``(seed, clock, size)``.

records.context: An engine owns no widget and no timer. It holds the constants rolled once from its seed, a clock (:attr:`time`), and whatever reusable buffer it paints through. Everything it draws is a pure function of ``(seed, time, width, height, colours, background)`` — which is what lets a test render the same frame twice and compare it byte for byte, and what lets :meth:`AmbientWidget.set_theme` swap engines without the animation jumping.

records.source: An engine owns no widget and no timer. It holds the constants rolled once from its seed, a clock (:attr:`time`), and whatever reusable buffer it paints through. Everything it draws is a pure function of ``(seed, time, width, height, colours, background)`` — which is what lets a test render the same frame twice and compare it byte for byte, and what lets :meth:`AmbientWidget.set_theme` swap engines without the animation jumping.
records.translation: Un motor no posee ningún widget ni temporizador. Contiene las constantes generadas una vez a partir de su semilla, un reloj (:attr:`time`) y el búfer reutilizable a través del cual pinte. records.source: What to multiply every element's peak alpha by, given the density.

records.context: Additive compositing means N overlapping shapes are N times the light, so a density control with no compensation is a *brightness* control wearing a misleading name. Measured, on a page at 0.076: mean frame lightness went from 0.135 at density 1.0 to 0.288 at 3.0. The backdrop would have become the loudest thing behind a settings form — which the alphas in this module were set on a rendered frame specifically to prevent (see :data:`AURORA_ALPHA_DARK`).
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientEngine.alpha_scale#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Additive compositing means N overlapping shapes are N times the light, so a density control with no compensation is a *brightness* control wearing a misleading name. Measured, on a page at 0.076: mean frame lightness went from 0.135 at density 1.0 to 0.288 at 3.0. The backdrop would have become the loudest thing behind a settings form — which the alphas in this module were set on a rendered frame specifically to prevent (see :data:`AURORA_ALPHA_DARK`).
records.translation: La composición aditiva significa que N formas superpuestas suman N veces la luz, por lo que un control de densidad sin compensación es un control de *brillo* con un nombre engañoso. Medido sobre una página a 0.076: la luminosidad media del fotograma pasó de 0.135 con densidad 1.0 a 0.288 con 3.0. El fondo se habría convertido en lo más llamativo detrás de un formulario de ajustes — justo lo que los valores alfa de este módulo, fijados sobre un fotograma renderizado, pretendían evitar (véase :data:`AURORA_ALPHA_DARK`).

records.context: So above 1.0 the field's light is *divided among* more elements rather than added to it. Below 1.0 nothing is done: quadrupling the alpha of a quarter as many blobs clips to white rather than compensating, and a sparser field being a quieter one is the right answer anyway.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientEngine.alpha_scale#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So above 1.0 the field's light is *divided among* more elements rather than added to it. Below 1.0 nothing is done: quadrupling the alpha of a quarter as many blobs clips to white rather than compensating, and a sparser field being a quieter one is the right answer anyway.
records.translation: Así, por encima de 1.0 la luz del campo se *reparte entre* más elementos en lugar de sumarse. Por debajo de 1.0 no se hace nada: cuadruplicar el alfa de una cuarta parte de las manchas satura a blanco en lugar de compensar, y que un campo más disperso sea más tenue es, de todos modos, la respuesta correcta.

records.context: Density therefore changes the *texture* of the field — how many shapes it is made of, and how strongly each one states itself — and not how loud the field is. That is the only reading of the control that leaves the backdrop legible at both ends of its range.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientEngine.alpha_scale#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Density therefore changes the *texture* of the field — how many shapes it is made of, and how strongly each one states itself — and not how loud the field is. That is the only reading of the control that leaves the backdrop legible at both ends of its range.
records.translation: Por tanto, la densidad cambia la *textura* del campo — de cuántas formas se compone y con qué fuerza se manifiesta cada una — y no lo llamativo que es el campo. Es la única interpretación del control que deja el fondo legible en ambos extremos de su rango.

records.source: :meth:`geometry` yields ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` per sampled column of every curtain, in pixels, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` of them per curtain in curtain order. The painter builds its paths from exactly those numbers, so a test that tracks a fold crest through ``geometry`` is tracking the crest that is on screen. ``brightness`` is the travelling surge. Seeded irregular ray positions and independent continuous length and brightness cycles modulate the sampled sheet, with tapered tops. Roll the aurora's bands and their drift.
records.translation: :meth:`geometry` produce ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` por cada columna muestreada de cada cortina, en píxeles, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` por cortina y en el orden de las cortinas. El pintor construye sus trazados exactamente a partir de esos números, de modo que una prueba que sigue una cresta de pliegue mediante ``geometry`` sigue la cresta que está en pantalla. ``brightness`` es la oleada que se desplaza. Las posiciones irregulares de los rayos, generadas con semilla, y los ciclos continuos e independientes de longitud y brillo modulan la lámina muestreada, con extremos superiores ahusados. Genera las bandas de la aurora y su deriva.

records.source: Always built from the palette's *first* colour, wandering up to :data:`AURORA_HUE_BLEND` of the way towards one of the others and back. records.translation: Siempre se construye a partir del *primer* color de la paleta, desviándose hasta :data:`AURORA_HUE_BLEND` del camino hacia uno de los otros y volviendo. Dar a la segunda cortina un cuerpo rojo y a la tercera uno violeta, que es lo que haría indexar la paleta por cortina, es lo único que impide que todo el tema se lea como una aurora.

records.source: ``u`` runs 0..1 from one end of the arc to the other. That is the whole difference between an aurora and a curtain being dragged sideways, and it is the one property of this engine worth testing directly.
records.translation: ``u`` va de 0..1 de un extremo del arco al otro. Cada componente es ``sin(2*pi*(u - v*t)/lambda)``: en un instante fijo es una forma en ``u``, y a medida que avanza ``t`` esa forma *se desliza a lo largo de u* a ``v`` mientras el propio arco no se mueve. Esa es toda la diferencia entre una aurora y una cortina arrastrada de lado, y es la única propiedad de este motor que merece probarse directamente.

Es la misma aritmética; está aquí y no detrás de esas dos llamadas porque esto se ejecuta ciento veinte veces por fotograma y una llamada de Python no es gratuita. ``test_aurora_geometry_ is_the_model_it_documents`` mantiene unidas ambas formas.

Render cost is measured between frames and used to reduce buffer resolution and bud count when necessary. :meth:`geometry` returns the primary :class:`Form` first.
records.translation: El motor evalúa ``z <- z**2 + c`` para una forma principal y yemas derivadas opcionales. Un estado continuo obtenido por hash controla la profundidad, la densidad, el movimiento y la población como función pura de la semilla y del tiempo de animación. El coste de renderizado se mide entre fotogramas y se usa para reducir la resolución del búfer y el número de yemas cuando es necesario. :meth:`geometry` devuelve primero la :class:`Form` principal.

records.source: Fit dose–response curves; an EC50 is reported only when the data bound it.
records.translation: Ajusta curvas dosis–respuesta; solo se informa de una EC50 cuando los datos la acotan.

records.context: This module fits concentration series inside spaCR, so a screener with eight doses and three replicates does not need to export a CSV to another program. A fit always produces numbers, but **the answer is often "the EC50 cannot be determined from this experiment"**, and a plain least-squares fit does not report that. ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This module fits concentration series inside spaCR, so a screener with eight doses and three replicates does not need to export a CSV to another program. A fit always produces numbers, but **the answer is often "the EC50 cannot be determined from this experiment"**, and a plain least-squares fit does not report that. ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.
records.translation: Este módulo ajusta series de concentraciones dentro de spaCR, de modo que quien realiza un cribado con ocho dosis y tres réplicas no necesita exportar un CSV a otro programa. Un ajuste siempre produce números, pero **la respuesta suele ser "la EC50 no puede determinarse a partir de este experimento"**, y un ajuste por mínimos cuadrados simple no lo indica. ``curve_fit`` devolverá cuatro números y una matriz de covarianza para una serie de diluciones que nunca alcanzó una meseta, para una curva de citotoxicidad en forma de campana y para ocho puntos de puro ruido. Los tres resultados parecen una EC50 con un intervalo de confianza.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.context: Both are offered on ``log10_ec50`` and both back-transform:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#16
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Both are offered on ``log10_ec50`` and both back-transform:
records.translation: Ambos se ofrecen sobre ``log10_ec50`` y ambos se retransforman:

records.context: :data:`CI_WALD` — asymptotic, from the covariance matrix ``curve_fit`` returns, with a t quantile on ``n - 4`` degrees of freedom. Not a normal quantile: eight concentrations with no replicates leaves 4 df, where ``t = 2.776`` against ``z = 1.960``, a 42% difference in the width of the published interval.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#17
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :data:`CI_WALD` — asymptotic, from the covariance matrix ``curve_fit`` returns, with a t quantile on ``n - 4`` degrees of freedom. Not a normal quantile: eight concentrations with no replicates leaves 4 df, where ``t = 2.776`` against ``z = 1.960``, a 42% difference in the width of the published interval.
records.translation: :data:`CI_WALD` — asintótico, a partir de la matriz de covarianza que devuelve ``curve_fit``, con un cuantil t con ``n - 4`` grados de libertad. No un cuantil normal: ocho concentraciones sin réplicas dejan 4 gl, donde ``t = 2.776`` frente a ``z = 1.960``, una diferencia del 42% en la anchura del intervalo publicado.

records.context: :data:`CI_PROFILE` — profile likelihood, **the default**. For a grid of candidate ``log10_ec50`` values the other three parameters are re-optimised and the residual sum of squares is compared against ``SSE_min * (1 + t²/(n - 4))``, the standard F-based profile region for one parameter out of four. (``F(1, ν) = t(ν)²``, so the two intervals use literally the same quantile and differ only in the shape of the surface they walk.)
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#18
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :data:`CI_PROFILE` — profile likelihood, **the default**. For a grid of candidate ``log10_ec50`` values the other three parameters are re-optimised and the residual sum of squares is compared against ``SSE_min * (1 + t²/(n - 4))``, the standard F-based profile region for one parameter out of four. (``F(1, ν) = t(ν)²``, so the two intervals use literally the same quantile and differ only in the shape of the surface they walk.)
records.translation: :data:`CI_PROFILE` — verosimilitud de perfil, **el predeterminado**. Para una cuadrícula de valores candidatos de ``log10_ec50``, los otros tres parámetros se reoptimizan y la suma de cuadrados residual se compara con ``SSE_min * (1 + t²/(n - 4))``, la región de perfil estándar basada en F para un parámetro de cuatro. (``F(1, ν) = t(ν)²``, de modo que los dos intervalos usan literalmente el mismo cuantil y solo difieren en la forma de la superficie que recorren.)

records.context: The profile is the default for one reason that outweighs its cost: **the Wald interval is finite by construction.** It is ``L ± t·SE``, so it returns a finite, symmetric interval even for a curve whose midpoint the data does not locate at all. The profile interval can *fail to close*: the residual sum of squares stays under the threshold all the way out to a concentration ten thousand times the highest dose tested, and that failure is the diagnostic. It is reported as an open bound, not smoothed into a number.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#19
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The profile is the default for one reason that outweighs its cost: **the Wald interval is finite by construction.** It is ``L ± t·SE``, so it returns a finite, symmetric interval even for a curve whose midpoint the data does not locate at all. The profile interval can *fail to close*: the residual sum of squares stays under the threshold all the way out to a concentration ten thousand times the highest dose tested, and that failure is the diagnostic. It is reported as an open bound, not smoothed into a number.
records.translation: El perfil es el predeterminado por un motivo que pesa más que su coste: **el intervalo de Wald es finito por construcción.** Es ``L ± t·SE``, por lo que devuelve un intervalo finito y simétrico incluso para una curva cuyo punto medio los datos no localizan en absoluto. El intervalo de perfil puede *no cerrarse*: la suma de cuadrados residual se mantiene por debajo del umbral hasta una concentración diez mil veces mayor que la dosis más alta probada, y ese fallo es el diagnóstico. Se informa como un límite abierto, no se suaviza en un número.

records.context: Most of the decisions below concern when to withhold a result, and each is stated.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Most of the decisions below concern when to withhold a result, and each is stated.
records.translation: La mayoría de las decisiones siguientes se refieren a cuándo no dar un resultado, y cada una se justifica.

records.context: A residual bootstrap was the other candidate and was rejected. It shares the profile's homoscedastic-normal assumption so it buys no robustness; it needs a seed and gives a slightly different published number per seed; and — the deciding objection — percentiles of a bootstrap distribution are *always* finite, so it reports a confident-looking interval for an unidentified parameter in precisely the situation that matters. Nothing here resamples and nothing here is random: the same data gives the same interval, every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#20
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A residual bootstrap was the other candidate and was rejected. It shares the profile's homoscedastic-normal assumption so it buys no robustness; it needs a seed and gives a slightly different published number per seed; and — the deciding objection — percentiles of a bootstrap distribution are *always* finite, so it reports a confident-looking interval for an unidentified parameter in precisely the situation that matters. Nothing here resamples and nothing here is random: the same data gives the same interval, every time.
records.translation: Un bootstrap de residuos era el otro candidato y se descartó. Comparte el supuesto normal homocedástico del perfil, por lo que no aporta robustez; necesita una semilla y da un número publicado ligeramente distinto para cada semilla; y — la objeción decisiva — los percentiles de una distribución bootstrap son *siempre* finitos, por lo que informa de un intervalo de aspecto fiable para un parámetro no identificado precisamente en la situación que importa. Aquí nada se remuestrea y nada es aleatorio: los mismos datos dan el mismo intervalo, siempre.

records.context: ``bottom``, ``top`` and the Hill slope get Wald intervals only. Profiling each of them would quadruple the work for numbers that are rarely reported; the EC50 is the reported number.

records.translation: ``bottom``, ``top`` y la pendiente de Hill solo reciben intervalos de Wald. Calcular el perfil de cada uno cuadruplicaría el trabajo para números que rara vez se publican; la EC50 es el número que se publica.

records.context: Three failure cases
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#22
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three failure cases
records.translation: Tres casos de fallo

records.context: 1. **The curve is incomplete** — one plateau was never reached, or the midpoint sits outside the tested range. Then the EC50 is an extrapolation. :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50` is ``None`` in that case and the number lives in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_unconstrained`, under a name that cannot be mistaken for a result; :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_bounded` is ``False`` and :meth:`DoseResponseResult.bound_statement` gives the one-sided fact the experiment does support ("EC50 > 30 µM, the highest concentration tested"). Three independent detectors have to agree it is fine before a number is released: the fitted midpoint inside the tested dose range, the observed responses bracketing the fitted half-maximum, and neither fitted plateau more than :data:`PLATEAU_SLACK` of the observed response span outside the observed responses. 2. **The data is not monotone.** A bell shape — the classic being cytotoxicity killing the signal at the top dose — is not a 4PL, and a 4PL fitted to it returns a confident EC50 for a curve of the wrong shape. Detected from the concentration-ordered per-dose medians and **refused**, with the concentrations where it turns named in the message. See :func:`monotonicity`. 3. **There is not enough experiment.** Four parameters need at least four distinct concentrations (:data:`MIN_DOSES`) and, to say anything about uncertainty, more observations than parameters (:data:`MIN_OBSERVATIONS`). A constant response has no curve in it. A **zero concentration is not an error** — a vehicle control is normal and belongs in the file — so it is excluded from the fit deliberately, counted, and reported as a reference response, never fed to ``log10``. A *negative* concentration has no such reading and is refused.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#23
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. **The curve is incomplete** — one plateau was never reached, or the midpoint sits outside the tested range. Then the EC50 is an extrapolation. :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50` is ``None`` in that case and the number lives in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_unconstrained`, under a name that cannot be mistaken for a result; :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_bounded` is ``False`` and :meth:`DoseResponseResult.bound_statement` gives the one-sided fact the experiment does support ("EC50 > 30 µM, the highest concentration tested"). Three independent detectors have to agree it is fine before a number is released: the fitted midpoint inside the tested dose range, the observed responses bracketing the fitted half-maximum, and neither fitted plateau more than :data:`PLATEAU_SLACK` of the observed response span outside the observed responses. 2. **The data is not monotone.** A bell shape — the classic being cytotoxicity killing the signal at the top dose — is not a 4PL, and a 4PL fitted to it returns a confident EC50 for a curve of the wrong shape. Detected from the concentration-ordered per-dose medians and **refused**, with the concentrations where it turns named in the message. See :func:`monotonicity`. 3. **There is not enough experiment.** Four parameters need at least four distinct concentrations (:data:`MIN_DOSES`) and, to say anything about uncertainty, more observations than parameters (:data:`MIN_OBSERVATIONS`). A constant response has no curve in it. A **zero concentration is not an error** — a vehicle control is normal and belongs in the file — so it is excluded from the fit deliberately, counted, and reported as a reference response, never fed to ``log10``. A *negative* concentration has no such reading and is refused.
records.translation: 1. **La curva está incompleta** — nunca se alcanzó una de las mesetas, o el punto medio queda fuera del rango probado. Entonces la EC50 es una extrapolación. En ese caso :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50` es ``None`` y el número se encuentra en :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_unconstrained`, con un nombre que no puede confundirse con un resultado; :attr:`DoseResponseResult.ec50_bounded` es ``False`` y :meth:`DoseResponseResult.bound_statement` da el hecho unilateral que sí respalda el experimento ("EC50 > 30 µM, la concentración más alta probada"). Tres detectores independientes tienen que coincidir en que todo está bien antes de publicar un número: el punto medio ajustado dentro del rango de dosis probado, las respuestas observadas a ambos lados de la semimáxima ajustada, y ninguna de las mesetas ajustadas más de :data:`PLATEAU_SLACK` del intervalo de respuesta observado fuera de las respuestas observadas. 2. **Los datos no son monótonos.** Una forma de campana — el caso clásico es la citotoxicidad que anula la señal en la dosis más alta — no es un 4PL, y un 4PL ajustado a ella devuelve una EC50 de aspecto fiable para una curva de forma equivocada. Se detecta a partir de las medianas por dosis ordenadas por concentración y se **rechaza**, nombrando en el mensaje las concentraciones en las que cambia de sentido. Véase :func:`monotonicity`. 3. **No hay suficiente experimento.** Cuatro parámetros necesitan al menos cuatro concentraciones distintas (:data:`MIN_DOSES`) y, para decir algo sobre la incertidumbre, más observaciones que parámetros (:data:`MIN_OBSERVATIONS`). Una respuesta constante no contiene ninguna curva. Una **concentración cero no es un error** — un control de vehículo es normal y debe estar en el archivo — por lo que se excluye deliberadamente del ajuste, se cuenta y se informa como respuesta de referencia, y nunca se pasa a ``log10``. Una concentración *negativa* no admite tal interpretación y se rechaza.

records.context: It is nonetheless **not the default**. The fifth parameter trades off against the Hill slope — many (slope, asymmetry) pairs draw nearly the same curve — so on the eight or ten concentrations a plate actually carries it is weakly identified, and the profile interval it produces is correspondingly wider. The module therefore offers it, fits it **from the 4PL solution** so the asymmetric search starts at the symmetric answer, and reports an extra-sum-of-squares F test of the one added parameter in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` so a reader can see whether the asymmetry was worth what it cost.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#26
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: It is nonetheless **not the default**. The fifth parameter trades off against the Hill slope — many (slope, asymmetry) pairs draw nearly the same curve — so on the eight or ten concentrations a plate actually carries it is weakly identified, and the profile interval it produces is correspondingly wider. The module therefore offers it, fits it **from the 4PL solution** so the asymmetric search starts at the symmetric answer, and reports an extra-sum-of-squares F test of the one added parameter in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` so a reader can see whether the asymmetry was worth what it cost.
records.translation: Aun así, **no es el predeterminado**. El quinto parámetro se compensa con la pendiente de Hill — muchos pares (pendiente, asimetría) dibujan casi la misma curva — de modo que, con las ocho o diez concentraciones que realmente contiene una placa, está débilmente identificado, y el intervalo de perfil que produce es en consecuencia más ancho. Por eso el módulo lo ofrece, lo ajusta **a partir de la solución 4PL** para que la búsqueda asimétrica empiece en la respuesta simétrica, e informa en :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` de una prueba F de suma de cuadrados extra del único parámetro añadido, para que el lector pueda ver si la asimetría valió lo que costó.

records.context: R² on a sigmoid is nearly uninformative. Any monotone curve through a microplate sample position-sampled dose–response scores above 0.95, because the total sum of squares is dominated by the difference between the two plateaus and *any* S-shaped line captures that. :meth:`DoseResponseResult.caveats` says so next to the number, every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#36

records.source: R² on a sigmoid is nearly uninformative. Any monotone curve through a well-sampled dose–response scores above 0.95, because the total sum of squares is dominated by the difference between the two plateaus and *any* S-shaped line captures that. :meth:`DoseResponseResult.caveats` says so next to the number, every time.
records.translation: R² en una sigmoide es casi irrelevante. Cualquier curva monótona a través de una dosis–respuesta bien muestreada supera 0.95, porque la suma total de cuadrados está dominada por la diferencia entre las dos mesetas y *cualquier* línea en forma de S la captura. :meth:`DoseResponseResult.caveats` lo indica junto al número, siempre.

records.context: The lack-of-fit test does the real work when replicates exist: pure error (within-concentration scatter, ``n - m`` df) is a model-free estimate of noise, and the residual variance in excess of it (``m - 4`` df) is model-misspecification. A small p-value means a 4PL is the wrong shape for this data whatever the R² says. With no replicates there is no pure-error estimate and the test does not exist — which is itself reported, because "cannot be tested" and "passed" are different states.

records.source: The lack-of-fit test does the real work when replicates exist: pure error (within-concentration scatter, ``n - m`` df) is a model-free estimate of noise, and the residual variance in excess of it (``m - 4`` df) is model-misspecification. A small p-value means a 4PL is the wrong shape for this data whatever the R² says. With no replicates there is no pure-error estimate and the test does not exist — which is itself reported, because "cannot be tested" and "passed" are different states.
records.translation: La prueba de falta de ajuste hace el trabajo real cuando hay réplicas: el error puro (dispersión dentro de cada concentración, ``n - m`` gl) es una estimación del ruido independiente del modelo, y la varianza residual que la excede (``m - 4`` gl) es error de especificación del modelo. Un valor p pequeño significa que un 4PL tiene la forma equivocada para estos datos, diga lo que diga R². Sin réplicas no hay estimación del error puro y la prueba no existe — lo cual también se informa, porque "cannot be tested" (no se puede probar) y "passed" (superada) son estados distintos.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#5

records.source: Three reasons, all of which show up in real data:
records.translation: Tres motivos, todos los cuales aparecen en datos reales:

records.context: **The doses are geometric.** A 2- or 3-fold dilution series is evenly spaced in log concentration and violently uneven in linear concentration. The information the experiment carries about the midpoint is information about *which dilution step* it sits on, which is a statement in log space.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The doses are geometric.** A 2- or 3-fold dilution series is evenly spaced in log concentration and violently uneven in linear concentration. The information the experiment carries about the midpoint is information about *which dilution step* it sits on, which is a statement in log space.
records.translation: **Las dosis son geométricas.** Una serie de diluciones de 2 o 3 veces está espaciada uniformemente en la concentración logarítmica y de forma muy desigual en la concentración lineal. La información que aporta el experimento sobre el punto medio es información sobre *en qué paso de dilución* se encuentra, lo cual es una afirmación en el espacio logarítmico.

records.context: **The likelihood surface is close to symmetric in log10(EC50) and badly skewed in EC50.** That is what makes a quadratic (Wald) approximation defensible on ``log10_ec50`` and indefensible on ``EC50``.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The likelihood surface is close to symmetric in log10(EC50) and badly skewed in EC50.** That is what makes a quadratic (Wald) approximation defensible on ``log10_ec50`` and indefensible on ``EC50``.
records.translation: **La superficie de verosimilitud es casi simétrica en log10(EC50) y muy asimétrica en EC50.** Eso es lo que hace defendible una aproximación cuadrática (Wald) sobre ``log10_ec50`` e indefendible sobre ``EC50``.

records.context: **A linear-space interval routinely reaches below zero**, and a negative concentration is impossible: an EC50 of ``1.0 ± 1.4 µM`` is an interval that includes impossible values.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A linear-space interval routinely reaches below zero**, and a negative concentration is impossible: an EC50 of ``1.0 ± 1.4 µM`` is an interval that includes impossible values.
records.translation: **Un intervalo en espacio lineal llega habitualmente por debajo de cero**, y una concentración negativa es imposible: una EC50 de ``1.0 ± 1.4 µM`` es un intervalo que incluye valores imposibles.

records.context: Reporting therefore back-transforms the *interval*: ``10 ** [lo, hi]``. The result is multiplicative (``0.62 – 1.61 µM`` around 1.0, a 1.6-fold factor either way), always positive, and multiplicative like potency itself.

records.context: Pooling is two-stage. One joint nonlinear mixed model would be the other way to do it; it would also mean a second fitting path with a second set of failure modes, and a plate that :func:`fit_dose_response` refuses would have to be refused again, differently, inside it. records.translation: La agrupación se hace en dos etapas. records.translation: La agrupación usa efectos aleatorios en lugar de fijos. La agrupación de efectos fijos supone que todas las placas miden el mismo valor y solo difieren por el ruido. records.translation: **La prueba F es bilateral y la hipótesis es unilateral**, ya que solo una estimulación positiva es hormesis. El criterio 1 resuelve la parte unilateral por inspección en lugar de dividir el valor p por la mitad, de modo que el p informado es conservador en aproximadamente un factor de dos. records.context: The interactive twin of :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_scale_location`, used as the variance-homogeneity panel. A residual-vs-fitted plot shows the mean and the variance at once and a reader has to separate them by eye; taking the square root of the absolute standardised residual removes the sign, so what is left is only the spread. A rising trend means the standard errors -- and therefore every p-value on the volcano -- are wrong in a direction that depends on the fitted value.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.ScaleLocationPlot#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The interactive twin of :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_scale_location`, used as the variance-homogeneity panel. A residual-vs-fitted plot shows the mean and the variance at once and a reader has to separate them by eye; taking the square root of the absolute standardised residual removes the sign, so what is left is only the spread. A rising trend means the standard errors -- and therefore every p-value on the volcano -- are wrong in a direction that depends on the fitted value.
records.translation: El gemelo interactivo de :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_scale_location`, usado como panel de homogeneidad de la varianza. Un gráfico de residuos frente a ajustados muestra la media y la varianza a la vez, y el lector tiene que separarlas a ojo; tomar la raíz cuadrada del residuo estandarizado absoluto elimina el signo, de modo que solo queda la dispersión. Una tendencia ascendente significa que los errores estándar -- y, por tanto, todos los valores p del volcán -- son incorrectos en una dirección que depende del valor ajustado.

records.translation: Así, la altura es el P sin ajustar, que es continuo y es la evidencia de cada prueba, y la corrección decide el color y la línea de umbral, que son discretos. What makes it a gate rather than a lasso is that it is a **predicate**, not a list of objects:

records.context: Point-in-polygon uses the vectorised even–odd ray-casting rule. A row whose x or y is missing is **outside every gate**. Its state is not "unknown", and it is not silently kept. An object with no measurement is not inside the region. Letting it through would put objects with no value into a population the user defined by value; the same rule :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` applies to NaN.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec#11

records.source: Point-in-polygon is the even–odd ray-casting rule, vectorised. A row whose x or y is missing is **outside every gate** — not "unknown", not silently kept. An object with no measurement is not an object inside the region, and letting it through would put objects with no value into a population the user defined by value; the same rule :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` applies to NaN.
records.translation: El punto en polígono usa la regla par-impar de lanzamiento de rayos, vectorizada. Una fila cuyo x o y falta queda **fuera de todas las compuertas** — no "unknown" (desconocida), ni se conserva silenciosamente. Un objeto sin medición no es un objeto dentro de la región, y dejarlo pasar introduciría objetos sin valor en una población que el usuario definió por valor; es la misma regla que :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` aplica a NaN.

records.context: :meth:`GateSet.stats` reports, per data-selection boundary, the count, the percentage **of its parent** and the percentage of the whole table. records.translation: El gesto de cuenca: se hace clic dentro de una población y la compuerta encuentra su borde. Partiendo del objeto más cercano al clic, la selección toma repetidamente todos los objetos no seleccionados que estén a menos de ``tolerance`` de algo ya seleccionado, y se detiene cuando nada nuevo está lo bastante cerca. This is what makes it a WATERSHED rather than a circle -- the selection flows along a dense ridge and stops at a gap, so an elongated or bent population comes out whole and the sparse space around it does not. ``max_radius`` how far from the CLICK the selection may reach at all. Without it a single chain of objects bridging two populations merges them, which on a real scatter happens more often than not.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.wand_select#2

records.source: ``tolerance`` how far apart two objects can be and still count as neighbours. Without it a single chain of objects bridging two populations merges them, which on a real scatter happens more often than not.
records.translation: ``tolerance`` la distancia máxima a la que pueden estar dos objetos para seguir considerándose vecinos. Esto es lo que lo convierte en una CUENCA y no en un círculo -- la selección fluye a lo largo de una cresta densa y se detiene ante un hueco, de modo que una población alargada o curvada sale entera y el espacio disperso a su alrededor no. ``max_radius`` hasta dónde puede llegar la selección desde el CLIC. Sin ello, una sola cadena de objetos que una dos poblaciones las fusiona, lo que en un diagrama de dispersión real ocurre más a menudo que no.

records.translation: Este panel muestra :mod:`spacr.measurement_scan` junto a las ejecuciones de regresión. Los ajustes del modelo se mantienen fijos mientras cambia la medición dependiente. records.context: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per laboratory microplate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight laboratory microplates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the main GUI execution path before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per plate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight plates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the GUI thread before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.
records.translation: Se pregunta a :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` y no a ``os.path``. Esta propiedad la lee una vez por fila de placa `_fill_table`, y de nuevo `paths`, `screens` y `describe` -- de modo que un proyecto con ocho placas en un montaje `autofs` en reposo suponía ocho consultas de veinte segundos en el hilo de la GUI antes de que la pestaña dibujara nada. La sonda responde desde una caché, informa como presente una ruta que no ha visto y la consulta en su propio trabajador acotado; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` es la mitad que corrige la fila cuando llega la respuesta real.

So it draws from what `refresh` asked for, waits at most :data:`READ_BUDGET_S` for anything not back yet, and says "reading…" for the rest until :meth:`_on_read_landed` corrects it.
records.translation: Se llama en cada clic, por lo que no puede leer las bases de datos cada vez. records.source: This composes the two existing merges and adds nothing else. :func:`spacr.multi_database.read_merged` is *many databases, one table*; :func:`spacr.merge_tables.merge_tables` is *one database, many tables* and takes a path, so it cannot be handed a frame that already spans databases. This runs the first per chosen table and then joins them with the second's own :func:`~spacr.merge_tables.roll_up` and :meth:`~spacr.merge_tables.MergePolicy.how_for`. There is no sum and no mean written here; every number comes from the rules.
records.translation: Esto compone las dos fusiones existentes y no añade nada más. :func:`spacr.multi_database.read_merged` es *muchas bases de datos, una tabla*; :func:`spacr.merge_tables.merge_tables` es *una base de datos, muchas tablas* y recibe una ruta, por lo que no se le puede entregar un marco que ya abarca varias bases de datos. Aquí no hay ninguna suma ni media escrita; cada número procede de las reglas.

records.translation: El artefacto se sigue escribiendo en el disco. Un usuario puede abrirlo, y todos los ajustes de una cola leen entonces los mismos números, que es lo que lo convirtió en un artefacto y no en una vista previa en primer lugar.

records.context: Nothing in this process parses it back. The frame is already in this process when it is written, and the fits run in this process too, so :func:`spacr.frame_handoff.stage` offers it under the path it wrote before the write returns. A four-plate screen merges to about 2.75 GB: the CSV write cost around 160 seconds before anything read it, and each fit then parsed the whole file back out of the page cache -- minutes of CPU with no disk I/O at all, which is what made a working run look hung.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_scan_panel.write_merged_frame#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Nothing in this process parses it back. The frame is already in this process when it is written, and the fits run in this process too, so :func:`spacr.frame_handoff.stage` offers it under the path it wrote before the write returns. A four-plate screen merges to about 2.75 GB: the CSV write cost around 160 seconds before anything read it, and each fit then parsed the whole file back out of the page cache -- minutes of CPU with no disk I/O at all, which is what made a working run look hung.
records.translation: Nada en este proceso lo vuelve a analizar. El marco ya está en este proceso cuando se escribe, y los ajustes también se ejecutan en este proceso, por lo que :func:`spacr.frame_handoff.stage` lo ofrece con la ruta que escribió antes de que termine la escritura. Un cribado de cuatro placas se fusiona en unos 2.75 GB: la escritura del CSV costaba unos 160 segundos antes de que nada lo leyera, y después cada ajuste volvía a analizar todo el archivo desde la caché de páginas -- minutos de CPU sin ninguna E/S de disco, que es lo que hacía que una ejecución en marcha pareciera colgada.

records.source: The offer is a weak reference, so it cannot keep a multi-gigabyte frame alive after the panel that merged it lets go, and a reader that was offered nothing reads the file exactly as before.
